Hello, this is VRANI.
We are excited to tell you about the latest patch and the special discount. Please take a look at the note below:

[b]<Patch Note - v1.8>[/b]
[list]
[*]Recycle Bin feature has been introduced.
[*]Fixed issue that the game sound (the narration) was not synced with the game progress.
[*]Fixed issue in switching the languages in the game.
[*]Fixed bug that the main window was not clickable after the tutorial.
[*]Fixed bug that the main window was not clickable in Episode 2-7 and 2-17.
[/list]

[b]<Special Discount>[/b]
We are offering a special [b]20% discount[/b] on Coding Adventure:
[list]
[*]From [b]2021-01-14 10:00am PST[/b] 
[*]To [b]2021-01-21 9:59am PST[/b]
[/list]
Enjoy the adventure now.

Thanks
VRANI
